notes.title: Neon Tide is now free
notes.notes: Just as the title suggests, Neon Tide can now be played for free along with a free version of the soundtrack.  Thank you to the ones who supported us while it was paid.  We hope this allows a wider audience to enjoy the game as well.

notes.title: Neon Tide on Windows 7 - Windows 10!
notes.notes:
We would like to inform you that our game can now be played on Windows 7-10.  If you are playing on Windows 7 or 8.1 please make sure your drivers are up to date.

As for Linux, we found that this will be more difficult than we thought but we are working hard on figuring it out.  We will post an update once the Linux version is live as well.  

Thank you very much.

notes.title: Linux and Windows 7
notes.notes:
By middle October we are hoping to have stable version for Linux and Windows 7 users.  This was planned to be released at launch but according to our beta testers there are bugs we need to work out for those versions to run correctly.  

We hope the people playing the Windows 10 and Mac version are enjoying them.  We will post here once the update for Linux and Windows 7 go live.  Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Small delay
notes.notes:
Hey all.  Due to circumstances out of our control, we had to push our release date.  We hope this doesn't inconvenience too many and you will continue to support us as we work to release the best game we can.  The new release date is 9/16/19.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact us and we will do our best to get back to you.  Thank you for your understanding.

-Skyride Studios
